import sqlite3,json,pathlib,collections
p=pathlib.Path('data/lexicon_builder/2026-11-12/ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-api-checkpoint/candidate.db');c=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro',uri=True)

 domains,trace=map(json.loads,c.execute('select domains,trace from definition_states where entry_id=?',(eid,)).fetchone())
